messages:
ivy: Heads-up — wrapping internal notes for v7.3.4. Need final blurb + pin confirmation before I schedule the blast. Can we run a deploy-bot staging dry-run so SRE & accounts can see exact text?
sam: Draft blurb: 'v7.3.4: improved batching heuristics to reduce tail latency. No API changes; compat maintained.' Two short lines.
harper: Please include the Dedicated pin string so account teams don't scramble.
acct-team: Pinned artifact for Dedicated is runtime-pro@v7.3.4 (sha: e5d9c2). We'll reference that in outreach.
ivy: Perfect. Add rollback policy: auto rollback to v7.3.3 if 4m error rate > 0.75% OR p95 latency +35% over 4m.
sam: Also suggest an alert softening for the first 7m instead of muting — raise thresholds so initial noise doesn't spam oncall.
oncall: We can raise error threshold to 1.2% and latency delta to +55% for first 7m. Noted.
ivy: @deploy-bot run a staging dry-run that mirrors prod copy and pins thread 9800001234 so docs can copy verbatim.
deploy-bot: staging dry-run accepted for thread 9800001234. Emitting messages flagged [STAGING DRY-RUN]. ETA ~90s.
deploy-bot: dry-run output:
- "[STAGING DRY-RUN] Release v7.3.4 scheduled. Canary: us-east 20m -> ramp to 45% over 15m. Pin: runtime-pro@v7.3.4 (e5d9c2)"
- "Rollback: 4m error rate > 0.75% OR p95 latency increases > 35% -> automatic rollback to v7.3.3"
- "Initial alert adjustment: error_rate threshold -> 1.2% for first 7m; p95 delta threshold -> +55% for first 7m"
- "Owners: ivy (release), sam (docs), harper (deploy), oncall (pager), acct-team (customer comms)"
ivy: Nice. Can someone paste the deploy config snippet for the release notes appendix? Keep it minimal.
harper: Snippet: ```
canary: { region: "us-east", duration: "20m" }
ramp: { to: "45%", duration: "15m" }
pin: "runtime-pro@v7.3.4 (e5d9c2)"
blackout: { region: "eu", start: "23:30Z", end: "02:30Z" }
alerts: { initial_adjust: { error_rate: "1.2%", p95_delta: "+55%", window: "7m" } }
rollback: { window: "4m", error_rate: "0.75%", p95_delta: "+35%", fallback: "v7.3.3" }
```
sam: I'll put that exact snippet in the internal note appendix. Also adding a one-line account heads-up for Dedicated customers.
acct-team: queued account-facing note and DMing reps with the pin string. We'll escalate if any VIPs need a different deployment lane.
ivy: Who will post the internal blast? Need it T-6 (6 minutes before canary) to give folks a chance to react.
sam: I can post and pin. Scheduling for 2024-11-10T13:54:00Z (T-6). I'll tag owners and account reps.
oncall: After sam posts, I'll validate pager thresholds and blackout windows. Also will run the preflight checklist during canary start.
ivy: One last tiny edit: change 'compat maintained' -> 'backward compatible' for clarity.
sam: updated. Final blurb: 'v7.3.4: improved batching heuristics to reduce tail latency. No API changes; backward compatible.'
harper: Configs staged, deploy ready. Leaving thread open for last-minute copy edits. :rocket:
